paite: Huan zawlneite tapate'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai mun na kiang a ka tenna uh kou a ding in akochik lua hi.
heading: Heitang Muh Nawnna
english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

paite: K'on ngen uh. Jordan lui ah ka hohsuk ding ua, huai ah sing ka va la chiat ding ua, ka tenna ding uh huai ah ka va lam ding uh aw?" achi uhi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuan ve ua,” achi hi.
english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

paite: Mi khat in, "Na sikhate kiang ah hoh sam in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hoh sam leng akei dia," chi in adawng hi.
english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

paite: Huchi in akiang uah ahoh samta hi. Jordan lui atun un sing aphuk uhi.
english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

paite: Mi khat in aphuk san lai in, aheitang tui ah akia hi. Ama'n, "Maizen! Pu, mi a kikhel ei ve," chi in akikou hi.
english: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

paite: Pathian mipa in, "Koi lai ah ahia akiak?" achi hi. Ama'n akiakna mun a-ensak hi. Huchi in singhiang khat asat a, huai ah apailut a, sik ahong kilam hi.
english: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

paite: Ama'n, "Tawm aw le," achi a; huchi in asawk a, atawmta hi.
english: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n Israelte ahong dou in, huai mun ah giahphual ka sat ding, chi in asikhate thu akum hi.
heading: Siria Sepaihte Zoh Ahi Uh
english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

paite: Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huchibang mun a hoh lou ding in pilvang in. Huai ah Siriate ahong suk ding uh," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Pathian mipa'n ana hilhna mun mi ava enkhesak zel hi. Huai ah khatvei nihvei phet lou in, ana kihumbit zel hi.
english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

paite: Huchi in huai thu ah Siria kumpipa lungtang amangbanggawp hi. Asikhate asam a, akiang uah, "I lak ua mi akua pen ahia Israel kumpipa lam a pang? N'on hilh kei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

paite: Asikhate lak a mi khat in, "Kuamah pang kei ve ung e, kumpipa, ka toupa aw. Israel gam a om zawlnei Elisha in na dantan sunggil a na gente Israel kumpipa ana hilh zel ahi zaw hi." achi hi.
english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

paite: Ama'n, "Koi a om ahia va simzon un, ka va mansak ding," achi hi, "Ngai in, Dothan ah a-om,” chi in ahilh uhi.
english: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

paite: Huchi in sakolte, kangtalaite leh sepaih tampite huai ah asawl a, zan in ava hoh ua, khua a-umkimvel uhi.
english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

paite: Pathian mipa sikha zingkhang in athou a, ava pawtkhiakleh, ngai in, sepaihte'n sakol leh kangtalaite toh khua ana umsuakta uh. Sikha in akiang ah, "Maizen! Pu aw, bang i chihta dia le?" achi hi.
english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

paite: Ama'n, "Lau ke'n; amau lam a pangte sang in ei lam a pangte atamzaw hi,” achi hi.
english: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha athum a, "TOUPA, amuhtheihna ding in amit vaksak in," achi hi. TOUPA'N huai tangval mit avaksak a; huchi in amu samta a; ngai in, Elisha kimvel a mualte mei kangtalai leh sakol in adim vekta hi.
english: Elisha prayed, and said, “Yahweh, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Yahweh opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

paite: Amah lam a ahong paisuk uleh TOUPA kiang ah Elisha athum a, "Hiai mite mit tawsak in," achi hi. Huchi in Elisha thu bang in amit uh atawsakta hi.
english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

paite: Elisha in akiang uah, "Hiai lampi ahi kei, hiai leng khua ahi sam kei. Kei hon zui un, na mizonpa uh kiang ah ka hon pi ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Samaria ah apita hi.
english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

paite: Samaria khosung atun un hichi ahong hi a, Elisha in, "TOUPA, hiaite'n amuhtheihna ding un amit uh vaksak in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amit uh avaksak a, amuta ua; ngai in, Samaria khosung ah ana omta uhi.
english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “Yahweh, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” Yahweh opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n amaute amuh in Elisha kiang ah, "Ka pa aw, ka that diam? Ka that diam?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "That ke'n, na namsau leh na thalpeu in na salmatte na that dia hia? Tanghou leh tui ama uah lui inla, ne in dawn uhenla, apu uh kiang ah paikik nawn uhen," achi hi.
english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

paite: Huchi in nek ding thupi mahmah abawlsak a; anek ua adawn khit un apaisak vek ua, apu uh kiang lam ah apai nawn uh. Huchi in Siria pawlte Israel gam ah ahong nawnta kei uhi.
english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm a, Samaria khua ava um hi.
heading: Samaria Khua Um Bichilhna
english: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

paite: Samaria ah kial anasa mahmah a, ngai in, sabiltung lutang dangka sawmgiat a akhot uh leh begap kab mun li a khen mun khat dangka nga a lei ahih tan hial un, khua a-um bikbek hi.
english: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

paite: Israel kumpipa kulh dawn a apai lai in numei khat in, "Aw kumpipa, ka toupa, hon huh in," chi in ana sam hi.
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA'N ahon panpih ngal keileh ke'n koi a pan in ahia ka hon panpih ding? Buhphual ahihkeileh grep sukna khuk a pan in maw?"
english: He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na chi a ahia awi?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hiai numei in ka kiang ah, tuni in na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh ve, zingchiang in ka tapa i ne na kei dia," achi hi.
english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

paite: Huchi in ka tapa ka huan ua, ka ne uh. Azing in ke'n akiang ah, "Na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh sam in, ka chi hi. Ama'n atapa aselgu maimah hi,” achi hi.
english: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

paite: Kumpipa'n numei thugen azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a; kulh dawn a apai lai ahi a; mipite'n a-et uleh, ngai in, asa tung ah sai-ip puan ana silh nilouh hi.
english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Tuni a Shaphat tapa Elisha in alutang apuak lai peuhmah leh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a leng thupizaw in," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

paite: Elisha a-inn ah atu a, upate leng akiang ah atu sam uh. Kumpipa'n akiang ah mi khat asawl a, himahleh amisawl akiang atun ma in upate kiang ah, "Hiai tualthatpa tapa in ka lu la ding in mi ahon sawl, chih na thei na uhia? Pau kei dih ua, amisawl ahong tun chiang in, kong na khak unla, kongkhak in na dal bikbek un. Anung ah apu kalsuan ging akiza kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

paite: Huchi a amau ahoupih san lai in, ngai in, amisawl ahong tungsuk hi. Ngai in, kumpipa'n, "Hiai thil hoih lou TOUPA hon sawl ahi; bang ding in TOUPA ka hungaih lailai dia? chi ahi," achi hi.
english: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from Yahweh. Why should I wait for Yahweh any longer?”
